acceptance: Positive, negative and adversarial fixture descriptors are strict, parseable and seeded; generated fixtures match the committed files byte for byte and load into the test runner.

positive.fixture: 22 descriptors round-trip with unique ids and seeded files are reproducible

negative.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-registry --test harness -- malformed_descriptors_are_rejected

security_and_source_permissions: Registry data carries no credentials; no real source app was observed, and source-account permissions stay outside the registry.
performance_memory_storage: Generator is a seeded integer PRNG; generation of nine fixtures takes milliseconds.
known_limitations: Fixtures are synthetic; no real source capture exists yet
